title: Expositio in Psalmos Psalm Μʹ opening
english: Lemma-led open on ΨΑΛΜΟΣ Μʹ. — Ἵνα ἡ Γραφὴ πληρωθῇ, ὁ τρώγων μετ' ἐμοῦ τὸν ἄρτον, ἐπῆρεν ἐπ' ἐμὲ πτέρναν αὐτοῦ·
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 69 Expositio in Psalmos (CPG 5202) via Khazarzar.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
No copyrighted English base. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify; skip Pusey-PD / Greystone / Lunn / Hill.
